chapters.t: This is the story of Jesus, who came from the family of David and of Abraham.
Mary was going to marry Joseph when an angel came with astonishing news.
“Do not be afraid,” said the angel. “Mary’s baby is a gift from God.”
“You shall call him Jesus, because he will save his people.”
And so Jesus was born, and they named him Emmanuel too, which means “God is with us”.
Wise men far away in the east saw a bright new star and knew a king had been born.
They travelled a very long way, following the star.
The star stopped over the place where the child was, and they were filled with joy.
They knelt down and gave him gold, frankincense and myrrh.
Then God warned them in a dream to go home by a different road, and they did.
When Jesus was grown, a man called John was teaching by the river Jordan.
John told everyone, “Turn back to God — someone far greater than me is coming.”
Jesus came to be baptised, and John said, “It is you who should baptise me!”
As Jesus came up out of the water, God’s Spirit came down like a dove.
And a voice from heaven said, “This is my Son, whom I love. I am very pleased with him.”
Jesus went out into the desert and was alone there for forty days.
He was hungry, and a tempting voice said, “Turn these stones into bread.”
Jesus answered, “People do not live on bread alone, but on every word from God.”
Three times he was tested, and three times he stayed true.
Then Jesus walked by the sea and saw fishermen: Peter, Andrew, James and John.
“Come and follow me,” he said — and they left their nets at once and went with him.
Crowds came to hear Jesus, so he went up a hillside and sat down to teach them.
“Happy are the gentle,” he said, “and happy are those who make peace.”
“Happy are those who are sad, for God will comfort them.”
“You are the light of the world. Nobody lights a lamp and hides it under a bowl.”
“Love your enemies, and be kind to those who are unkind to you.”
“When you give to someone in need,” said Jesus, “do it quietly.”
“And when you pray, you can talk to God simply, like this:”
“Our Father in heaven, may your name be honoured, and your kingdom come.”
“Give us today the food we need, and forgive us, as we forgive others.”
“Look at the birds — God feeds them. You matter far more, so do not worry.”
“Do not be quick to judge other people,” Jesus said.
“Ask, and it will be given to you. Keep looking, and you will find.”
“Treat other people the way you would like them to treat you.”
“Anyone who hears my words and does them is like a wise builder.”
“He built his house on rock. The rain fell, the wind blew, and the house stood firm.”
“But the house built on sand fell down with a great crash.”
Jesus got into a boat, and his friends went with him across the lake.
Jesus was so tired that he fell fast asleep.
A fierce storm blew up, and the waves came right over the sides of the boat.
His frightened friends woke him: “Lord, save us! We are going to drown!”
Jesus stood up and said to the wind and the waves, “Be still.”
At once everything went calm, and his friends whispered, “Who is this?”
